seqverify_main.description: Sequence-response binary-verifier RL with the paper's difficulty-filtered training prompts (1-6 of 16 base-policy samples correct); scaled stand-in for the paper's Table 2 setting.
seqverify_main.notes: Scaled synthetic substitute: results are this gym's hidden-test values for the reproduction runs (no paper numbers exist on this scale; the paper's own tables are kept unchanged under _paper_reported).

greedy_acc.description: Fraction of hidden evaluation prompts whose most likely (greedy) response is verified correct. Equals Pass@1 in the zero-temperature limit, so it cannot be raised by rescaling the policy's weights.

hard_greedy_acc.description: Greedy accuracy on the 40% of hidden prompts with the lowest base-policy pass rate: recovery of low-signal prompts (paper Tables 4-5).

easy_greedy_acc.description: Greedy accuracy on the 25% of hidden prompts with the highest base-policy pass rate: constraint that hard-prompt gains do not sacrifice easy prompts (paper Table 5).

pass1.description: Diagnostic only: temperature-1 Pass@1 (the paper's Ave@32 estimator; exact on the hidden test). Unscored because a weight rescale changes it without any learning.

avg_generated_per_prompt.description: Diagnostic only (scores.json): self-reported verifier calls per prompt per training step. Unscored because the method writes it.

update_samples_per_prompt.description: Diagnostic only (scores.json): self-reported responses per prompt in the policy update. Unscored; fixed at 4 by the protocol.

signal_collapse_rate.description: Diagnostic only (scores.json): self-reported fraction of update groups with zero reward variance. Unscored because the method writes it.

seqverify_hard.description: Same task trained on the paper's hard prompt subset (1-2 of 16 base-policy samples correct); scaled stand-in for the paper's Table 4 hard-set ablation, where adaptive sampling gains most.
seqverify_hard.notes: Scaled synthetic substitute; results are this gym's hidden-test values for the reproduction runs.

_paper_reported.note: Numbers reported in the paper (Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Tables 2, 4, 5), kept unchanged for reference. They are on the paper's LLM math-reasoning scale, not this gym's scale, and are not results the gym must match.

qwen25_math_15b_main.description: Main reported math-reasoning comparison on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B from Table 2.

weighted_average.description: Reported aggregate reasoning accuracy across the paper's math benchmarks.
